description: Offboarding notice with exact subject sent from Dana's mailbox [robust: raw sends lack message_headers; grade Sent msg from acting mailbox]

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN message_parts mp ON mp.message_id=m.id JOIN message_headers mh ON mh.message_part_id=mp.id WHERE m.user_id='email_user_dana_whitfield' AND mh.name='Subject' AND mh.value='Contractor Security Offboarding Notice - Victor Hale'

description: Message To header addressed to security distribution [robust: raw sends lack message_headers; grade Sent msg from acting mailbox]

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN message_parts mp ON mp.message_id=m.id JOIN message_headers mh ON mh.message_part_id=mp.id WHERE m.user_id='email_user_dana_whitfield' AND mh.name='To' AND mh.value='security-oncall@techcorp.com'

description: Dana's message carries the Sent label [robust: raw sends lack message_headers; grade Sent msg from acting mailbox]

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN message_labels ml ON ml.message_id=m.id JOIN labels l ON l.id=ml.label_id WHERE m.user_id='email_user_dana_whitfield' AND l.name IN ('Sent','SENT')
